description: Source code for a PO file parser in the tinygettext library, implementing parsing of .po translation files including headers, msgid, msgstr, and plural forms.

classes.name: POParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing .po files, handling headers, message entries, and error recovery.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse the .po file stream and populate the dictionary.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with filename and line number context.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message and attempts to recover by skipping to the next entry.

methods.name: next_line
methods.description: Reads the next line from the input stream and updates line number and eof status.

methods.name: get_string_line
methods.description: Extracts a string from a line, handling escape sequences and Big5 encoding if applicable.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the current line, handling multi-line strings.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses the header of the .po file to extract charset and plural forms.

methods.name: is_empty_line
methods.description: Checks if the current line is empty or a comment.

methods.name: prefix
methods.description: Checks if the current line starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing loop that processes the entire .po file content.
